title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Fruit Twist Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Fruit Twist delivers a lively blend of tropical and orchard fruits, mixing sweet, tangy and juicy notes for a smooth and vibrant vape. The result is a full-bodied fruit medley with just the right touch of freshness. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod includes a prefilled 2ml pod attached to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, totalling 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No refilling or coil changes required—simply connect to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. Dual mesh coil technology ensures crisp flavour and reliable vapour for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
